items.heading: These Sit on Top These
items.text: These Sit on Top These These Sit on Top These sit on top of the general questions worth asking any counselling provider, who actually counsels you, whether pricing is transparent, whether outcomes are framed honestly. For a student, four more things separate a genuinely good fit from a process that just happens to also serve students.

items.heading: "Follow Your Passion" Is Not
items.text: "Follow Your Passion" Is Not "Follow your passion" is not stream-specific credibility. A process that can name real trade-offs between your exact options is doing more work than one offering broad reassurance.

items.heading: Not Every Provider Adds
items.text: Not every provider adds the same thing once the four checks above hold up. This is the difference they point to.

items.heading: A Student's Decision Usually Involves
items.text: A student's decision usually involves a second stakeholder in the room: a parent or family member with their own concerns about cost, safety, and long-term outcomes. How that gets handled matters as much as the counselling content itself.

items.heading: No Honest Provider, Including This
items.text: No honest provider, including this one, can guarantee an admission outcome, a rank, or a placement. Treat that promise as a warning sign, not a selling point.

items.heading: A Paid Conversation Earns Its
items.text: A paid conversation earns its cost once the decision is close, expensive, or already causing real friction at home.
